name: Vision of Disorder
description: '''Vision of Disorder''' is an American [[metalcore]] band from [[Long Island, New York]]. Formed in 1992, the band initially released three albums before disbanding in 2002. They garnered attention for blending melody and [[Groove metal|groove]] into a traditional [[Hardcore punk|hardcore]] framework, but their attempts to pursue an [[alternative metal]] direction on their fourth album were met with limited commercial success.  The band reunited in 2008 and has since released two further albums, ''[[The Cursed Remain Cursed]]'' in 2012 and ''Razed to the Ground'' in 2015.
